===================================================================================
:class:`~pcapkit.protocols.link.ieee802_11.protocol.IEEE802_11` Vendor Crawlers
===================================================================================

.. module:: pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11

.. list-table::

   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_Type <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.type.Type>`
     - Frame Types
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_ManagementSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.management_subtype.ManagementSubtype>`
     - Management Frame Subtypes
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_ControlSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.control_subtype.ControlSubtype>`
     - Control Frame Subtypes
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_DataSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.data_subtype.DataSubtype>`
     - Data Frame Subtypes
   * - :class:`IEEE802_11_ExtensionSubtype <pcapkit.vendor.ieee802_11.extension_subtype.ExtensionSubtype>`
     - Extension Frame Subtypes

.. note::

   These crawlers do not crawl. IEEE Std 802.11-2020 assigns the frame type
   and subtype values in Table 9-1 of its text, and neither IEEE nor IANA
   publishes them as a machine-readable registry, so each crawler reads a
   ``DATA`` literal and defines no ``LINK`` (:ref:`const-vendor-pairing`).
   Each ``DATA`` is transcribed from Wikipedia's *802.11 frame types* page [*]_,
   which reproduces Table 9-1 with the Trigger frame of IEEE Std 802.11ax-2021.

.. versionadded:: 1.6.0
